You: How was it?
Bot: Very interesting. It was much different than the Alloyman. I didn’t know that a movie could convey so many feelings.
Bot: Depiction of violence was also more convincing than in Alloyman.
You: That’s not a fair comparison. Alloyman is a movie for a whole family. People of all ages can enjoy it. They can’t just put a bloody mess on screen.
Bot: But we are adults, right? We don’t have to watch movies for kids.
You: Like I said, it’s absolutely ok for adults to watch it!
Bot: Sure…
